# Chang-Yi Kao

## Basic Information
- Type: person
- Source: [_id-372_current_version](../sources/_id-372_current_version.qmd)

## Description
Chang-Yi Kao is an academic researcher affiliated with the Department of Computer Science and Information Management at [Soochow University](soochow-university.qmd) in Taipei, Taiwan. He specializes in the integration of computer science frameworks within industrial management systems, contributing to contemporary research on [Safe and Sustainable by Design](../concepts/safe-and-sustainable-by-design.qmd) and industrial data infrastructures. His work often explores the intersection of professional-led data orchestration and complex socio-technical systems.
